item.title: CloudService
item.description: This guide uses Alibaba Cloud as an example to walk you through obtaining your own public internet address. For other cloud service providers, please refer to their respective documentation for purchasing and setup instructions. Benefits of a Dedicated Server Excellent Performance — MetMessage’s server is only responsible for forwarding messages, with extremely simple logic. With security features disabled, even the lowest-tier or even free cloud servers can easily support over 200 concurrent online users for chat services.

item.title: Guidance
item.description: User Guide for the App. Continuously being improved. Registration and Login Registration is entirely local—no information is sent to the server. I define who I am. Logging in simply notifies your friends that you are online. No other information is transmitted to the server. Note 1: You can register multiple times locally. Each registration creates a brand new identity. You can reduce the workload of re-registering by backing up and restoring your groups and contacts.

item.title: Marketing
item.description: Because MetMessage’s core design philosophy is to keep both data and logic on the client app, the server is responsible for forwarding messages only. Setting up your own MetMessage server is very simple. In this post, I’ll show you how to quickly and easily deploy a dedicated server. PS: I hope to find time in the future to provide a one-click deployment service for everyone—stay tuned. Benefits of a Dedicated Server MetMessage Security Logic 1
